headline: 500+ YOUTHS RECLAIMED FROM THE STREETS
summary: Over five hundred young people have stepped out of gang pressures and street life into safehouse mentorship circles. Each one represents a story of choosing purpose over survival, and a future reclaimed from the margins.

headline: 75% DROP IN LOCAL YOUTH CRIME RATES
summary: Through proactive outreach in hot-spot zones, late-night mentorship, and consistent presence, Langas has seen a dramatic decline in youth-related crime. The streets are safer because the youth chose a different path.

headline: 42+ STUDIO TRACKS & STAGE SHOWS
summary: From the studio booth to community stages, the New Breed has produced over forty conscious music tracks and live performances. Raw talent refined into powerful messages of peace, identity, and ambition.

headline: 12+ COMMUNITY CLEAN-UPS COMPLETED
summary: Youth-led sanitation campaigns have cleared drainage lines, reclaimed illegal dump zones, and transformed neglected spaces across Langas. Clean environments build clean minds and proud communities.

headline: 06 NEIGHBORHOOD TOURNAMENTS HOSTED
summary: Six inter-estate sports tournaments have brought divided peer networks and rival neighborhoods onto the same field. Football and basketball became the language of peace, turning rivals into teammates.

headline: 150+ PEER COUNSELING SESSIONS
summary: Over one hundred fifty rescue circles and psychological support sessions have tackled the substance abuse crisis head-on. Trained peer counselors provide a lifeline — no judgment, just a path back to clarity.
